interaction_history.overview: Advertising man Roger Thornhill is mistaken for a spy, triggering a deadly cross-country chase.
interaction_history.title: North by Northwest

interaction_history.overview: Dangerous Liaisons is the film based on the novel of the same name by Choderlos de Laclos set in 18th century France. Marquise de Merteuil’s asks her ex-lover Vicomte de Valmont to seduce the future wife of another ex-lover of hers in return for one last night with her. Yet things don’t go as planned in this love triangle drama.
interaction_history.title: Dangerous Liaisons

interaction_history.overview: A recent college graduate finds himself in a love triangle with an older woman and her daughter.
interaction_history.title: Graduate, The

interaction_history.overview: Almost Famous is an autobiographical inspired film about a 15-year-old who is hired by Rolling Stone magazine to follow and interview a rock band during their tour. A film about growing up, first love, disappointment, and the life of a rock star.
interaction_history.title: Almost Famous

interaction_history.overview: At the start of the first World War, in the middle of Africa’s nowhere, a gin soaked riverboat captain is persuaded by a strong-willed missionary to go down river and face-off a German warship.
interaction_history.title: African Queen, The

interaction_history.overview: Rootless Hungarian émigré Willie, his pal Eddie, and visiting sixteen-year-old cousin Eva always manage to make the least of any situation, whether aimlessly traversing the drab interiors and environs of New York City, Cleveland, or an anonymous Florida suburb.
interaction_history.title: Stranger Than Paradise

interaction_history.overview: New York police detective John Shaft arrests Walter Wade Jr. for a racially motivated slaying. But the only eyewitness disappears, and Wade jumps bail for Switzerland. Two years later Wade returns to face trial, confident his money and influence will get him acquitted -- especially since he's paid a drug kingpin to kill the witness.
interaction_history.title: Shaft

interaction_history.overview: In a dystopian future Australia, a vicious biker gang murders a cop's family, and makes his fight with them personal.
interaction_history.title: Mad Max

interaction_history.overview: A beautiful girl, Snow White, takes refuge in the forest in the house of seven dwarfs to hide from her stepmother, the wicked Queen. The Queen is jealous because she wants to be known as "the fairest in the land," and Snow White's beauty surpasses her own.
interaction_history.title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs

interaction_history.overview: Ground control has been receiving strange transmissions from the three remaining residents of the Solaris space station. When cosmonaut and psychologist Kris Kelvin is sent to investigate, he experiences the strange phenomena that afflict the Solaris crew, sending him on a voyage into the darkest recesses of his own consciousness. Based on the novel by the same name from Polish author Stanislaw Lem.
interaction_history.title: Solaris (Solyaris)
